Trainer: Typical finish with paperwork queues on my list. Keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk calm and check every handoff.
Coordinator: Use the ledger right away and flag any service change before boarding starts.
Planner: <<FACT F018>> Place the pet relief note beside the escort plan and keep the tone steady.
Handler: If a traveler seems unsure, listen first, then send the issue to the senior coordinator.
Dispatcher: <<FACT F027>> Confirm the quarantine paperwork, then route the kennel assignment cleanly.
Trainer: Do the same for the skyport intake review and leave no gaps in the log.
Planner: <<FACT F007>> After that, confirm carrier checks and remind staff to stay focused.
Coordinator: Close the thread with a clear note, then file the update with Aurelia Skyways.
